references.title: 労働基準法 art.24(1) proviso: a deduction from wages other than taxes and social insurance needs a written agreement with the majority union or representative (賃金控除協定; company.facts.wage_deduction_agreement); art.25: an advance of wages already earned for an emergency must be paid on request.

労働基準法 art.24(1) proviso (賃金控除協定 required) and art.17: a loan may not be set off against wages as a condition of work (前借金相殺の禁止); recovery by deduction is only the employee's voluntary repayment under the agreement.

name: 非常時払 (emergency payment of earned wages)

references.title: 労働基準法 art.25 with 施行規則 art.9: for childbirth, illness, disaster, marriage, death or an unavoidable trip of the worker or a dependant, the wages already earned are paid on request before the pay day; the advance is settled from that pay (task EMERGENCY_PAYMENT).
